subject.title: Tool call observability: input sanitization, error categorization, and context writeback

question: What permanent contract should OpenClaw use for tool-call observability and writeback auditability: diagnostics-only events, ToolResultMessage schema fields, a durable metadata-only audit ledger, or a split of those surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work crosses privacy defaults, transcript compatibility, exporter cardinality, and durable audit storage, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary by itself.

options.title: Adopt metadata-only audit plus narrow diagnostics
options.body: Use the metadata-only audit-ledger direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 for durable accountability, and keep separate narrow PRs for soft-error diagnostics and any ToolResultMessage compatibility work.

options.title: Keep this issue as the broad canonical item
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until maintainers explicitly split the ToolResultMessage, exporter, and writeback pieces into separate canonical issues.

options.title: Defer ToolResultMessage changes
options.body: Treat diagnostics and the audit ledger as the supported observability path and close or narrow the ToolResultMessage field request after maintainers confirm that API direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt metadata-only audit plus narrow diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-only audit-ledger direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 for durable accountability, and keep separate narrow PRs for soft-error diagnostics and any ToolResultMessage compatibility work.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the active metadata-only audit-ledger proposal and have recent adjacent ownership signals around state, lifecycle, and tool payload safety.
